project_name: Web App Manajemen Pondok Pesantren Al-Hasani Limpung
theme: Light theme default with rich Emerald primary, Warm Gold accents, and crisp Slate data tables. Optional high-contrast dark mode support.

administrator.access: Full System Access (Santri, Pengurus, Ustadz, Kamar, Jadwal, Absensi, Pembayaran, Kenaikan Kelas, Keuangan, System Config)
administrator.billing_rights: Can override payment status (e.g. set Dibebaskan / PKL exemption for specific months)

pengurus.access: Absensi Input, Pembayaran & Kwitansi, Pendaftaran Santri Baru, Input Jadwal Ngaji, Keuangan Cash Ledger
pengurus.billing_rights: Can input payments, issue receipts with logged-in signature

ustadz.access: Absensi Input Only (Input attendance for assigned jadwal ngaji & classes)

santri.login: NIS (Nomor Induk Santri) with default password '111111'
santri.access: Santri Portal Only (View personal billings/tagihan, jadwal mengaji, and attendance history/daftar kehadiran)

business_rules_fees.billing_start_rule: Terhitung sejak 1 bulan setelah tanggal pendaftaran santri baru.
business_rules_fees.pkl_exemption_rule: Administrator dapat mengubah status bulan tertentu (contoh: Juni) menjadi 'Dibebaskan (PKL)' sehingga santri tidak dibebani biaya bulanan.
business_rules_fees.receipt_header:
PONDOK PESANTREN ALHASANI LIMPUNG
Jl. KH. Wahid Hasyim No. 01 Limpung
business_rules_fees.receipt_signature: Nama Pengurus / Administrator yang sedang login

key_components_and_pages.name: Auth / Login Page
key_components_and_pages.description: Unified dual tab login: Staff/Pengurus/Ustadz (Email) and Santri (NIS). Shows prominent helper notice for Santri default password '111111'.

key_components_and_pages.name: Dashboard Overview
key_components_and_pages.description: Metric summaries (Total Santri, Kehadiran Hari Ini, Total Kas Pesantren, Tagihan Belum Lunas) + Top 5 Santri Ter-rajin & Top 5 Santri Ter-malas based on attendance rate + Quick Actions.

key_components_and_pages.name: Data Santri & Pendaftaran Baru
key_components_and_pages.description: Santri directory grid/table with filter by status/class/room, NIS generator, register new santri modal automatically calculating registration fee (150k) and setting up monthly billing schedule.

key_components_and_pages.name: Kenaikan Kelas (Bulk Class Promotion)
key_components_and_pages.description: Select origin class, filter active santri, bulk check selection, assign target new class & academic year, preview changes, execute promotion, and view class promotion history log.

key_components_and_pages.name: Jadwal Ngaji & Absensi Input
key_components_and_pages.description: Schedule CRUD per Kitab/Ustadz/Waktu. Matrix attendance input view (Hadir, Sakit, Izin, Alpha) for date & schedule with batch save and auto stats calculator.

key_components_and_pages.name: Pembayaran & Monthly Billing Grid
key_components_and_pages.description: Interactive 12-month billing matrix per santri (Jan-Des). Status indicators: Lunas, Belum Lunas, Dibebaskan (PKL). Admin option to override month status to 'Dibebaskan (PKL)'. Quick payment modal with invoice receipt generator.

key_components_and_pages.name: Cetak Kwitansi C5 Landscape
key_components_and_pages.description: Dedicated printable component formatted strictly for Envelope C5 Landscape (229mm x 162mm) with official header 'PONDOK PESANTREN ALHASANI LIMPUNG, Jl. KH. Wahid Hasyim No. 01 Limpung', payment details, terbilang text, watermark badge, and official signature block with logged-in user name.

key_components_and_pages.name: Keuangan (Simple Cash Ledger & Report)
key_components_and_pages.description: Income (Pemasukan: Pendaftaran, SPP Bulanan, Donasi) & Expense (Pengeluaran: Operasional, Listrik, Konsumsi) ledger, summary charts, and printable cash report.

key_components_and_pages.name: Santri Portal
key_components_and_pages.description: Personalized student dashboard showing active bills/tagihan (100k/mo), next study schedule (jadwal mengaji), and personal attendance statistics (persentase kehadiran & log).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) for all React components in /app/frontend/src/.
Ensure ALL interactive buttons, input elements, tables, tab triggers, modal actions, and key values include explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Ensure login supports email for Staff/Admin/Ustadz and NIS for Santri with clear default password indicator '111111'.
Implement Top 5 Santri Ter-rajin (highest % kehadiran) and Top 5 Santri Ter-malas (lowest % / highest alpha) on Administrator & Pengurus dashboards.
Implement Kenaikan Kelas with bulk selection, class target dropdown, execution preview, and historical class promotion log.
Implement monthly payment grid @ Rp 100.000 starting 1 month after registration, registration fee @ Rp 150.000, and administrator payment status override for PKL (Dibebaskan).
Implement Envelope C5 Landscape (229mm x 162mm) print layout with exact Pesantren header and signature of currently logged-in user.
Ensure Sonner toast feedback for all CRUD operations, payment submissions, status updates, and print actions.
Never leave dropdowns or header backgrounds completely transparent without backdrop blurs or solid fills.

anti_slop_rules: Avoid default Vercel-style blue or sterile grey. Use rich Emerald (#065F46) + Amber Gold (#D97706) tones tailored for Islamic educational institutions.
Use layered shadows, crisp 1px borders (slate-200/80), and rich contrast badges.
Do NOT add text-align: center to the root App container.
Do NOT use generic emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_and_padding: Generous spacing scale: containers with borders MUST have p-4 to p-6 padding to prevent content text collision.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
